versions.content: For Time Bases 16 t o 31 the StbM_GetCurrentTime() and StbM_GetCurrentTime Extended () shall return for the requested Time Base an absolute time value calcula ted by adding the given offset to the current Time Base of the referenced Time Base via StbMOffsetTimeBase ( ECUC_StbM_00030 : ).
